lines.speaker: Perchten
lines.text: Ohohoho what do we have here… what a child, what a cute little child! Cleaned the room, the whole room! See no dust, no dust at all! Oh what a precious thing you are!

lines.speaker: Perchten
lines.text: It’s such a shame, ma’dear that I am utterly out of time, oh, so out of time.

lines.speaker: Perchten
lines.text: I could chat with you and made you a lovely, oh, JUST LOVELY piece of meat pie.

lines.speaker: Perchten
lines.text: You’d have such a lovely, tender, delicate, REFINED meat…

lines.speaker: Perchten
lines.text: But still I must go… Continue getting rid of the mess, ma’sweetie, oh continue getting RID OF IT!

lines.speaker: Perchten
lines.text: What a generous child, oh, what a generous one! GIVE IT!

lines.speaker: Perchten
lines.text: I shall drink it, oh, I will drink it all alone…

lines.speaker: Perchten
lines.text: And you little precious child continue with that filthy house, continue your good work!
